Picking an org prefixes the name with `org/`; picking the personal account leaves it unprefixed. The lookup is best-effort — any API error simply skips the owner prompt so behavior degrades gracefully. Both `createFromScratch` and `createFromLocal` now pass their existing `httpClient`/`host` through.
